vars.name: --list-item-padding-y
vars.description: Vertical padding of an item (follows the density's row padding)

vars.description: Horizontal padding of an item (follows the density's row padding)

vars.name: --list-item-gap
vars.description: Space between the icon, the content and the actions

vars.name: --list-divider-color
vars.description: Color of the dividers between items

vars.name: --list-icon-size
vars.description: Size of the leading icon slot

vars.name: --list-border-color
vars.description: Border color of a bordered list (defaults to --border-color)

vars.name: --list-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of a bordered list (defaults to --radius-lg)

vars.name: --list-background
vars.description: Background of a bordered list (defaults to --surface-color)

vars.name: --list-item-hover-background
vars.description: Background of a row of a bordered list on hover / while a control inside it has the focus

translationResources.title: List
translationResources.description: Quiet operational lists on native ul / li elements with primary and secondary text, a decorative icon and trailing actions.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The list contains iPhone 16 and MacBook Air. Each Delete action removes only its own device.

compact.title: Compact density
compact.description: density="compact" lowers the minimum row height; dividers can be turned off.

bordered.title: Bordered card
bordered.description: bordered frames the list as a card whose rows are tinted on hover and while a control inside them has the focus; density="comfortable" gives taller rows.

ListProps.density: Minimum row height and vertical padding
ListProps.role: List role, kept so Safari / VoiceOver keep list semantics
ListProps.bordered: Frames the list as a card whose rows are tinted on hover / focus-within

ListItemProps.icon: Decorative leading slot, hidden from assistive technologies
ListItemProps.actions: Trailing controls owned by the caller

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: <minerva-list-item> rows with primary and secondary attributes; dividers separate adjacent items.

slots.title: Icons, rich text and actions
slots.description: The icon, default, secondary and actions slots. The rows add no command: Remove is a regular button in the actions slot.

density.title: Density and dividers
density.description: density="compact" shortens the rows, no-dividers removes the separators, CSS variables tune color and padding.

bordered.title: Bordered card
bordered.description: The bordered attribute frames the list as a card (rows tinted on hover / focus-within); density="comfortable" gives taller rows.

props.noDividers: Removes the separators between items (the React library's dividers={false}).

slots.default: Primary content (alternative to the primary attribute).
slots.secondary: Supporting content (alternative to the secondary attribute).
slots.icon: Decorative leading icon (hidden from assistive technologies).

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The list contains iPhone 16 and MacBook Air. Each Delete action removes only its own device.

inset-groups.title: Inset groups
inset-groups.description: Inset groups using Cell; the preview follows the selected site theme and palette.

rich-rows.title: Rich rows
rich-rows.description: Rich rows using Cell; the preview follows the selected site theme and palette.

native.limitations: React Native uses CellGroup and Cell for this list. Browser ul/li semantics, DOM refs and CSS hover styling do not apply; the device deletion scenario is shared.
